description.value:
Requirement You are holding a religious symbol in one hand, and holding a vial of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.EGhUorZhB7nV73Ev]{Unholy Water} or similar Holy or Unholy consumables in the other.

You utter prayers and bless your icon with a divine implement, and hold it up to repel mindless or weak-willed creatures in antithesis of your deity’s sanctification. You expend your held consumable in the process, but a target mindless creature or creature with an intelligence modifier of -3 or less within 30 feet of you needs to make a @Check[fortitude|against:religion] saving throw against your Religion DC. If you follow a Holy deity and use a Holy consumable, you target creatures with the Undead trait. If you follow an Unholy deity and use an Unholy consumable, you target living creatures.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

A creature who becomes Stunned is immune to being Stunned by Repelling Icon for 24 hours. If you become a Master in Religion, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. If you become Legendary in Religion, you can target even target creatures who are not mindless and have a higher intelligence modifier, and creatures with the Holy and Vitality traits or Unholy and Void traits, whichever is applicable.
